headings: ## How Much Happiness Do You Know Is Possible?

rows.label: P1 (new)
rows.article: What do you picture when you wish someone well?
source: One aspect of love is wanting wellbeing for someone.
If the happiness you know is food, safety
notes: Turn 67 (E186), my own draft (experiments/t67-guide/drafts/lm4-p1-j6.txt; GROUNDING-lm4.md): what you picture when you wish someone well, practical love (babies get it), and how far the wish reaches depending on the happiness you know is possible. The turn-65 P1 read Human alone, but the h2 read AI over it with every P2 and P3 (its first sentence echoed the heading); without any P1 the h2 read Human (round t67c).
